svg.title: Farlands
svg.desc: Farlands, a voxel engine written from scratch in C++17 and Vulkan. An isometric island generated from the real seed-42 terrain floats next to the title.

g.text: A voxel engine built from scratch in C++ & Vulkan.
A voxel engine built from scratch in C++ & Vulkan.
Infinite procedural terrain · 8 biomes · chunk streaming · vertex ambient occlusion
island = real 18×18 patch of the seed-42 world · x 20→37, z 12→29
